note: Curated spine. Layer 1 of the sourcing mechanism in 13_BIBLIOGRAPHY_AND_SOURCING. Every reading reaches here first. Live search is Layer 2, Mystic tier and above, at most two per reading, and only when the curated set genuinely cannot serve.

entries.title: Astronomical Algorithms (2nd ed)
entries.application: Definitive reference for ephemeris calculation. The standard manual used by astronomical software developers worldwide.

entries.title: Explanatory Supplement to the Astronomical Almanac (3rd ed)
entries.venue: University Science Books, Mill Valley CA
entries.application: The USNO and HM Nautical Almanac Office joint reference. Source of authority for moon phase definitions and date conventions used in CDP.

entries.authors: Folkner, W.M., Williams, J.G., Boggs, D.H., Park, R.S. & Kuchynka, P
entries.title: The Planetary and Lunar Ephemerides DE430 and DE431
entries.application: The technical specification for the JPL ephemeris that Swiss Ephemeris is built on. Citation for any 'JPL-derived' claim CDP makes.

entries.authors: Casiraghi, L., Spiousas, I., Dunster, G.P., McGlothlen, K., Fernández-Duque, E., Valeggia, C. & de la Iglesia, H.O
entries.title: Moonstruck sleep: Synchronization of human sleep with the moon cycle under field conditions
entries.application: Argentinian field study showing real lunar synchrony in sleep timing absent artificial light. The cleanest current peer-reviewed evidence for a moon-cycle effect on humans.

entries.authors: Helfrich-Förster, C., Monecke, S., Spiousas, I., Hovestadt, T., Mitesser, O. & Wehr, T.A
entries.title: Women temporarily synchronize their menstrual cycles with the luminance and gravimetric cycles of the Moon
entries.application: Companion paper to Casiraghi et al. 2021, on menstrual cycle and lunar synchrony. Both should be cited together for the lunar effects layer.

entries.title: Time and the Highland Maya (Revised ed)
entries.venue: University of New Mexico Press, Albuquerque
entries.application: Ethnographic documentation of living K'iche' Maya daykeepers in Guatemala. The canonical citation establishing the distinction between ancient practice and modern Dreamspell.

entries.title: Breaking the Maya Code
entries.application: The decipherment story. Useful background for Oracle-tier readers who want the intellectual history of how Maya calendrics became readable.

entries.title: Skywatchers: A Revised and Updated Version of Skywatchers of Ancient Mexico
entries.application: The foundational archaeoastronomy text for Mesoamerica. Source for the claim that the 260-day count tracks genuine astronomical cycles.

entries.title: The Apotheosis of Janaab' Pakal: Science, History, and Religion at Classic Maya Palenque
entries.application: Aldana's full-length intellectual history of Maya astronomical thought. Oracle-tier depth source for Venus tables and Classic-period calendrics.

entries.title: The Madrid Codex: New Approaches to Understanding an Ancient Maya Manuscript
entries.application: Companion volume to Bricker and Bricker 2011. Specifically on the Madrid Codex which contains key 260-day count tables.

entries.title: Astronomy in the Maya Codices
entries.application: Definitive technical analysis of the Dresden, Madrid, and Paris Codices. Reference for any Venus or eclipse-table claim.

entries.title: New Age Sympathies and Scholarly Complicities: The History and Promotion of 2012 Mythology
entries.venue: Archaeoastronomy: The Journal of Astronomy in Culture, 24, 183-205
entries.application: Critical analysis essential to maintain scholarly distance from 2012 mythologies. Strengthens the credibility of CDP's transparency notes.

entries.title: Maya Calendar and Mesoamerican Astronomy
entries.venue: Encyclopedia of the History of Science (CMU)
entries.application: Definitive open-access scholarly overview by the leading authority. Cite directly in framework transparency notes from Initiate tier upward.

entries.authors: Šprajc, I., Inomata, T. & Aveni, A.F.
entries.title: Origins of Mesoamerican astronomy and calendar: Evidence from the Maya Lowlands
entries.application: Peer-reviewed evidence that the 260 day count tracks genuine astronomical cycles. The current best-evidence anchor for the Maya calendrics layer.

entries.title: The Mayan Factor: Path Beyond Technology
entries.application: The original 1987 publication that introduced the Harmonic Convergence framework which became Dreamspell. Primary source for the modern system.

entries.title: Dreamspell: The Journey of Timeship Earth 2013
entries.venue: Foundation for the Law of Time, Ashland OR
entries.application: The codification of the Dreamspell system including the 13-tone, 20-glyph Kin matrix CDP uses. Always cite alongside the academic clarification that this is not ancient Maya doctrine.

entries.title: The 2012 Phenomenon: New Age Appropriation of an Ancient Mayan Calendar
entries.venue: Nova Religio: The Journal of Alternative and Emergent Religions, 9(3), 24-38
entries.application: Peer-reviewed scholarly analysis of how Argüelles' framework relates to actual Maya tradition. The strongest single citation for the framework-transparency claim CDP makes.

entries.title: Saturn: A New Look at an Old Devil
entries.application: The foundational text in psychological astrology. Used at the Centre for Psychological Astrology (London). Reference for any Saturn-transit interpretation in CDP.

entries.title: The Astrology of Fate
entries.application: Greene's full statement on the relationship between archetypal patterns and lived experience. Oracle-tier interpretive reference.

entries.title: A double-blind test of astrology
entries.application: The most-cited empirical test of natal astrology. Carlson concluded astrologers could not match birth charts to personality profiles above chance. Including this strengthens CDP's intellectual honesty: CDP does not claim astrology predicts personality, it claims symbolic frameworks shape attention and meaning-making.

entries.title: Predictive Astrology: The Eagle and the Lark
entries.application: The leading modern text on progressions, eclipses, and saros cycles. Reference for Oracle-tier timing windows.

entries.title: Planets in Transit: Life Cycles for Living (2nd ed)
entries.application: The professional practitioner standard for transit interpretation. Cross-reference for every transit named in Mystic and Oracle tier readings.

entries.title: Cosmos and Psyche: Intimations of a New World View
entries.application: The principal philosophical defence of archetypal astrology by a tenured academic (CIIS / formerly Esalen). Foundational citation for CDP's cross-framework convergence argument.

entries.authors: Hartmann, P., Reuter, M. & Nyborg, H
entries.title: The relationship between date of birth and individual differences in personality and general intelligence: A large-scale study
entries.application: Large-N study finding only weak season-of-birth effects in personality, none consistent with sun-sign predictions. Cite alongside Carlson 1985 for honest framing.

entries.title: A History of Western Astrology, Volume I: The Ancient World
entries.application: Academic history by the founder of the Sophia Centre for the Study of Cosmology in Culture, University of Wales Trinity Saint David. Cite for any historical claim about Western astrology.

entries.title: A History of Western Astrology, Volume II: The Medieval and Modern Worlds
entries.application: Volume II of Campion's history. Together these are the only academic two-volume history of the practice.

entries.title: Hellenistic Astrology: The Study of Fate and Fortune
entries.application: The scholarly synthesis of ancient Greek astrological technique, by the practitioner most respected in academic astrology. For Oracle-tier Hellenistic lots and sect considerations.

entries.title: Lore and Science in Ancient Pythagoreanism (E.L
entries.venue: Minar Jr., Trans.). Harvard University Press, Cambridge MA
entries.application: The foundational modern Pythagoras scholarship. Establishes the genuine ancient material from later legend, which protects CDP's claims from inflation.

entries.title: Numerology: The Complete Guide (2 vols)
entries.application: Standard practitioner reference for personal year, life path, expression, and soul urge calculations. Calculation cross-check for Sonia Indigo's framework.

entries.title: Pythagoras and the Pythagoreans: A Brief History
entries.application: The standard short academic introduction. Cite for the philosophical lineage that grounds numerology in genuine Pythagorean tradition.

entries.title: Numerology: The Power in Numbers
entries.venue: Square One Publishers, Garden City NY
entries.application: The most academically disciplined of the modern Pythagorean numerology references. Use as the internal calculation standard.

entries.title: Pythagoras: His Life, Teaching, and Influence (S
entries.venue: Rendall, Trans.). Cornell University Press, Ithaca
entries.application: The most current scholarly biography. Translated from the German standard work. For Oracle-tier philosophical depth.

entries.title: Interoceptive predictions in the brain
entries.application: The neural-architecture paper for the constructed-emotion model. Bridges Craig's interoception work to Barrett's emotion theory.

entries.title: The Psychological Construction of Emotion
entries.application: The edited volume bringing together the leading constructionist researchers. For the broader theoretical context.

entries.title: How Emotions Are Made: The Secret Life of the Brain
entries.application: The accessible synthesis of the theory of constructed emotion. The single most important book for CDP's emotional-construction claim.

entries.title: The theory of constructed emotion: an active inference account of interoception and categorization
entries.application: The peer-reviewed statement of the theory. Required scholarly citation; the book alone is not sufficient for academic credibility.

entries.title: How do you feel? Interoception: the sense of the physiological condition of the body
entries.application: The most-cited interoception paper in neuroscience. Establishes the insula as the primary interoceptive cortex. Required citation.

entries.title: How do you feel, now? The anterior insula and human awareness
entries.application: Craig's update extending the interoceptive model to consciousness and self-awareness.

entries.authors: Garfinkel, S.N., Seth, A.K., Barrett, A.B., Suzuki, K. & Critchley, H.D
entries.title: Knowing your own heart: distinguishing interoceptive accuracy from interoceptive awareness
entries.application: The methodological paper establishing the accuracy/sensibility/awareness distinction. Required for any precise claim CDP makes about interoceptive practice.

entries.title: Interoception and emotion
entries.application: The cleanest short review linking interoception to emotion. Sussex group; central to the UK interoception research community.

entries.authors: Khalsa, S.S., Adolphs, R., Cameron, O.G., Critchley, H.D., Davenport, P.W., Feinstein, J.S., et al
entries.title: Interoception and Mental Health: A Roadmap
entries.venue: Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 3(6), 501-513
entries.application: The 2016 Interoception Summit consensus statement, signed by 24 of the field's leading researchers. The expert-defined definition CDP should cite when explaining interoception.

entries.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol
entries.venue: 2: Separation, Anxiety and Anger. Basic Books, New York
entries.application: Volume II. The separation responses that ground anxiety in unmet attachment needs.

entries.authors: Ainsworth, M.D.S., Blehar, M.C., Waters, E. & Wall, S
entries.title: Patterns of Attachment: A Psychological Study of the Strange Situation
entries.application: The Strange Situation procedure that operationalised secure, anxious, and avoidant styles. Source for any CDP claim about attachment styles.

entries.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol
entries.venue: 3: Loss, Sadness and Depression. Basic Books, New York
entries.application: Volume III. The grief and loss layer. Useful for shadow-work content involving loss themes.

entries.authors: Main, M., Kaplan, N. & Cassidy, J
entries.title: Security in infancy, childhood, and adulthood: A move to the level of representation
entries.venue: Monographs of the Society for Research in Child Development, 50(1/2), 66-104
entries.application: The Adult Attachment Interview. Establishes that adult mental representations of attachment predict their children's styles. The bridge from developmental to adult work.

entries.authors: Fonagy, P., Gergely, G., Jurist, E.L. & Target, M
entries.title: Affect Regulation, Mentalization, and the Development of the Self
entries.application: The mentalisation framework which extends attachment theory into adult emotional regulation. Particularly useful for shadow-work explanations.

entries.title: Pocket Guide to Interpersonal Neurobiology: An Integrative Handbook of the Mind
entries.application: The accessible companion to The Developing Mind. Useful as a public-tier explanatory source.

entries.title: Attachment in Adulthood: Structure, Dynamics, and Change (2nd ed)
entries.application: The current standard text on adult attachment. The empirical synthesis CDP should cite for relationship-reading claims at Mystic and Oracle tiers.

entries.title: The Developing Mind: How Relationships and the Brain Interact to Shape Who We Are (3rd ed)
entries.application: The interpersonal neurobiology synthesis. The cleanest single citation for the claim that relationships physically shape the brain across the lifespan.

entries.title: The Polyvagal Theory: Neurophysiological Foundations of Emotions, Attachment, Communication, and Self-Regulation
entries.application: The foundational statement of polyvagal theory. The 'neuroception' concept CDP cites in Volume 4 traces to this source.

entries.title: Visceral influences on brain and behavior
entries.application: The mainstream neuroscience review of body-to-brain pathways. Provides the more conservative scientific framing alongside Porges.

entries.title: Polyvagal Theory: A Science of Safety
entries.application: Porges's most recent peer-reviewed clarification of the theory and response to critics. Required citation alongside the 2011 book.

entries.title: The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory?
entries.application: Friston's defining statement of the free-energy principle. The mathematical foundation underneath Clark's framework.

entries.title: Whatever next? Predictive brains, situated agents, and the future of cognitive science
entries.application: The single most-cited statement of predictive processing for general cognitive science readers. Highly cited target article in BBS.

entries.title: The Predictive Mind
entries.application: The philosophical companion to Clark 2016. Tighter on the metaphysics, especially relevant for the 'frameworks shape what we experience' claim.

entries.title: Interoceptive inference, emotion, and the embodied self
entries.application: The bridge paper between predictive processing and interoception. Explicitly relevant to the daily-reading-as-conceptual-framing argument.

entries.title: Surfing Uncertainty: Prediction, Action, and the Embodied Mind
entries.application: The full philosophical synthesis. The book Volume 4 cites by name. Required for the predictive-processing layer of CDP's bridge.

entries.title: Sleep-dependent learning and memory consolidation
entries.application: The peer-reviewed primary source for the hippocampal-consolidation claim. Required scholarly citation.

entries.title: The memory function of sleep
entries.application: The Lübeck group's synthesis of how sleep consolidates declarative and procedural memory. Pairs with Walker.

entries.title: Why We Sleep: Unlocking the Power of Sleep and Dreams
entries.application: The accessible synthesis Volume 4 cites for the evening-reflection feature. Berkeley sleep neuroscientist; the most influential trade book on sleep science.

entries.title: The Organization of Behavior: A Neuropsychological Theory
entries.application: The book Volume 4 cites by year. The foundational text of neuroplasticity ('cells that fire together, wire together'). Required citation.

entries.authors: Pascual-Leone, A., Amedi, A., Fregni, F. & Merabet, L.B
entries.title: The plastic human brain cortex
entries.application: The Annual Review article on adult cortical plasticity. Strongest single citation for the claim that daily practice physically changes brain structure.

entries.title: Synaptic plasticity: multiple forms, functions, and mechanisms
entries.application: The cleanest mainstream review of synaptic plasticity mechanisms. Stanford group.

entries.title: Alchemical Studies
entries.venue: Collected Works, Vol. 13. Princeton University Press, Princeton NJ
entries.application: The volume Volume 4 cites for the central shadow-work claim. Required primary source.

entries.title: Aion: Researches into the Phenomenology of the Self
entries.venue: Collected Works, Vol. 9, Part II. Princeton University Press, Princeton NJ
entries.application: Jung's most systematic statement on the Self archetype and shadow integration. For Oracle-tier depth content.

entries.title: Man and His Symbols
entries.application: The accessible Jungian primer. Useful for general readers approaching shadow content for the first time.

entries.title: Jung's Map of the Soul: An Introduction
entries.application: The cleanest contemporary synthesis of Jungian individuation as a daily practice. Cited by name in Volume 4.

entries.title: The Principle of Individuation: Toward the Development of Human Consciousness
entries.application: Stein's full statement on individuation. For Oracle-tier depth on the integration framework underlying CDP's evening reflection.

entries.title: The Sacred and the Profane: The Nature of Religion (W.R
entries.venue: Trask, Trans.). Harcourt Brace, New York
entries.application: The most-cited single text in comparative religion on the structure of sacred time. Foundational for any claim that 'a day has a quality'.

entries.title: The Ritual Process: Structure and Anti-Structure
entries.application: The extension of van Gennep's framework. Liminality as a specific category, central to any analysis of daily ritual.

entries.title: The Interpretation of Cultures
entries.application: Geertz's 'thick description' framework, particularly the essays on religion as a cultural system. Foundational anthropology.

entries.title: Ritual Theory, Ritual Practice
entries.application: The leading modern synthesis of ritual theory. Cite for academic claims about the cognitive functions of ritual practice.

entries.title: The psychology of life stories
entries.application: The narrative-identity framework. Provides scientific grounding for the 'your cosmic signature' framing CDP uses for Birth Kin and Life Path.

entries.authors: Steger, M.F., Frazier, P., Oishi, S. & Kaler, M
entries.title: The Meaning in Life Questionnaire: Assessing the presence of and search for meaning in life
entries.application: The validated measure of meaning in life. Useful if CDP ever runs internal user studies on whether the platform increases meaning.

entries.title: Making sense of the meaning literature: An integrative review of meaning making and its effects on adjustment to stressful life events
entries.application: The most-cited synthesis of meaning-making research in clinical psychology. Required citation for any claim CDP makes about reading-as-sense-making.

entries.title: Writing about emotional experiences as a therapeutic process
entries.application: Pennebaker's most-cited synthesis of his expressive-writing paradigm. The original empirical foundation for journaling-as-intervention claims.

entries.title: Written emotional expression: Effect sizes, outcome types, and moderating variables
entries.venue: Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 66(1), 174-184
entries.application: The first major meta-analysis. Effect size approximately d = 0.47 across 13 studies on physical and psychological health outcomes.

entries.title: Experimental disclosure and its moderators: A meta-analysis
entries.application: The updated meta-analysis (146 studies). The strongest single statistical citation for CDP's daily-reflection mechanism.

entries.title: Written Exposure Therapy for PTSD: A Brief Treatment Approach for Mental Health Professionals
entries.application: The clinical extension to PTSD. Useful for the credibility argument that structured reflective writing is now a recognised therapeutic modality.

entries.title: Placebo effects: from the neurobiological paradigm to translational implications
entries.application: Benedetti's Turin group has produced the most rigorous placebo-mechanism research. This Neuron review is the field synthesis.

entries.title: Placebo effects in medicine
entries.application: Kaptchuk's NEJM perspective. The cleanest single citation for the position that expectation effects are real and clinically significant.

entries.title: The neuroscience of placebo effects: connecting context, learning and health
entries.application: The current standard reference on placebo neuroscience. Wager group at Dartmouth. Required for any rigorous discussion of expectation mechanisms.

entries.title: Signaling, solidarity, and the sacred: The evolution of religious behavior
entries.application: The leading evolutionary-anthropology framework on why ritual practice evolved. Useful for explaining why structured daily practice produces measurable wellbeing benefits.

entries.title: Superstitious, magical, and paranormal beliefs: An integrative model
entries.application: The mainstream individual-differences research on belief in symbolic frameworks. Useful background for understanding CDP's user psychology.

entries.title: Big Gods: How Religion Transformed Cooperation and Conflict
entries.application: Norenzayan's synthesis of how shared symbolic frameworks coordinate behaviour at scale. Background for the cultural argument behind CDP.

entries.authors: Roenneberg, T., Wirz-Justice, A. & Merrow, M
entries.title: Life between clocks: Daily temporal patterns of human chronotypes
entries.application: The Munich group's foundational chronotype work, source of the Munich Chronotype Questionnaire (MCTQ).

entries.authors: Schmidt, C., Collette, F., Cajochen, C. & Peigneux, P.
entries.title: A time to think: circadian rhythms in human cognition
entries.application: The foundational review of time-of-day effects on cognition. Cited with Cajochen et al. 2025 for the Pacing strip.

entries.title: The circadian clock and human health
entries.application: The standard short review of circadian misalignment and health. Pairs cleanly with Walker 2020 and Cajochen and Schmidt 2024 already in your list.

entries.title: A common alteration in effort-based decision-making in apathy, anhedonia, and late circadian rhythm
entries.application: Cambridge group (MRC Cognition and Brain Sciences Unit). The paper Volume 4 cites by name. Demonstrates time-of-day synchrony effects on motivated cognition. Required for the morning/midday/evening framing.

entries.authors: Cajochen, C., Reichert, C.F., Maire, M., Schmidt, C., et al.
entries.title: The Circadian Brain and Cognition
entries.application: The current best-evidence review on circadian regulation of cognition. The authority for the Pacing strip, kept distinct from numerology.

entries.authors: Raison, C.L., Klein, H.M. & Steckler, M
entries.title: The moon and madness reconsidered
entries.application: The systematic critique of the 'lunacy' literature. Cite alongside the supportive Cajochen 2013 work for honest framing of where lunar effects are well-supported and where they are not.

entries.title: Bipolar mood cycles and lunar tidal cycles
entries.application: NIH (Wehr was Chief of the Section on Biological Rhythms). Documents lunar synchrony in rapid-cycling bipolar disorder under controlled conditions. Among the strongest single peer-reviewed lunar-effects findings.

entries.authors: Dean, G., Mather, A. & Kelly, I.W
entries.title: Astrology
entries.venue: In G. Stein (Ed.), The Encyclopedia of the Paranormal (pp. 47-99). Prometheus Books
entries.application: The most thorough sceptical review of astrology research up to 1996. Companion to Carlson 1985 for the empirical balance.

entries.title: Belief in astrology: A social-psychological analysis
entries.application: The peer-reviewed sociological study of astrology belief in the UK. Useful for understanding the user base CDP serves.

entries.title: Synchronicity: Through the Eyes of Science, Myth, and the Trickster
entries.application: The cleanest accessible synthesis of synchronicity research that takes both Jungian and scientific perspectives seriously.

entries.title: The Archaic: The Past in the Present
entries.application: Glasgow philosopher; on how ancient symbolic systems remain operative in modern psychology. Background reading for the convergence claim.

entries.title: The Archetypal Cosmos: Rediscovering the Gods in Myth, Science and Astrology
entries.application: Le Grice extends Tarnas's archetypal cosmology with explicit attention to scientific worldview. The strongest single text for CDP's 'two telescopes' philosophical argument.

entries.title: Perception and Communication.
entries.application: The foundational filter model of attention. The starting reference for any claim about selective filtering of incoming stimuli. The 11 million bits per second to 50 conscious bits per second contrast traces back to this lineage.

entries.title: A feature-integration theory of attention.
entries.application: The most-cited paper in the attention literature. Establishes that attention binds features into coherent percepts. Reference for the Gestalt principle that perception requires active assembly, not passive reception.

entries.title: The attention system of the human brain.
entries.application: The three-network model of attention (alerting, orienting, executive control). The neural substrate behind the Compass's attention-cultivation claim. Pairs with Petersen and Posner 2012 update below.

entries.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain.
entries.application: The dorsal versus ventral attention systems distinction. Important for the claim that morning intention engages the dorsal goal-directed system, biasing what the ventral stimulus-driven system foregrounds during the day.

entries.authors: Seeley, W.W., Menon, V., Schatzberg, A.F., Keller, J., Glover, G.H., Kenna, H., Reiss, A.L. & Greicius, M.D
entries.title: Dissociable intrinsic connectivity networks for salience processing and executive control.
entries.application: The original mapping of the salience network as distinct from the central executive network. Cite alongside Menon and Uddin 2010 for any salience-network claim.

entries.title: Saliency, switching, attention and control: A network model of insula function.
entries.application: The salience network paper. Anchors the Compass's morning-priming claim in specific neural circuitry: anterior insula and anterior cingulate as the switching mechanism between default mode and central executive. Pairs with Seeley et al. 2007.

entries.title: The attention system of the human brain: 20 years after.
entries.application: The two decades-on synthesis. Establishes the consensus view of the three-network model and its developmental trajectory. Required for any developmental claim about attention training.

entries.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II [Laws of organisation in perceptual forms].
entries.application: The foundational paper of Gestalt psychology. Establishes the laws of perceptual organisation (proximity, similarity, continuity, closure, common fate). Cite for the principle that the brain perceives wholes, not assemblages.

entries.title: Principles of Gestalt Psychology.
entries.application: The most comprehensive Gestalt treatise. Definitive on the figure-ground distinction that grounds the Reading's convergence-card-on-top architecture.

entries.title: Gestalt Psychology: An Introduction to New Concepts in Modern Psychology.
entries.application: Köhler's mature statement of the Gestalt position, written for a general readership. The cleanest single reference for Gestalt principles outside the technical journal literature.

entries.authors: Perls, F., Hefferline, R.F. & Goodman, P
entries.title: Gestalt Therapy: Excitement and Growth in the Human Personality.
entries.application: The foundational text of Gestalt therapy. Establishes the present-moment field as the operative therapeutic ground. Cite for any reading that surfaces what is alive in the user's now rather than what is past or anticipated.

entries.title: Gestalt Therapy Integrated: Contours of Theory and Practice.
entries.application: The classical practitioner reference for Gestalt therapy as practised. Important for the present-moment focus that distinguishes the Compass from a journal-prompt app.

entries.title: Living at the Boundary: Collected Works of Laura Perls.
entries.application: Laura Perls co-founded Gestalt therapy with Fritz Perls and Paul Goodman; this collection captures her distinct contribution, particularly on the body-grounded present-moment field that the standard Perls/Hefferline/Goodman 1951 text understates. The Polster lineage already cited descends from the New York Institute Laura Perls established. This bibliography draws on training with Laura Perls directly.

entries.title: Awareness, Dialogue, and Process: Essays on Gestalt Therapy.
entries.application: The most theoretically rigorous modern Gestalt-therapy reference. Useful for the depth-psychological claim that the Compass surfaces awareness of what is, not directives about what should be.

entries.authors: Beck, A.T., Rush, A.J., Shaw, B.F. & Emery, G
entries.title: Cognitive Therapy of Depression.
entries.application: The foundational CBT manual. Required citation for any cognitive-restructuring claim. Beck's breakthrough was establishing that distorted thoughts maintain depression, and that examining them reduces it.

entries.title: Cognitive-Behavioral Treatment of Borderline Personality Disorder.
entries.application: The foundational DBT text. Linehan's integration of CBT with mindfulness and acceptance is conceptually adjacent to CDP's integration of cognitive framing with contemplative practice. Background reference for the multi-modal change literature.

entries.authors: Young, J.E., Klosko, J.S. & Weishaar, M.E
entries.title: Schema Therapy: A Practitioner's Guide.
entries.application: Young's schema therapy extends CBT into the deeper schema-level work that the Reading surface is positioned to do. Cite for any reading that surfaces a recurring underlying pattern across multiple intentions over time.

entries.authors: Bennett-Levy, J., Butler, G., Fennell, M., Hackmann, A., Mueller, M. & Westbrook, D. (Eds.)
entries.title: Oxford Guide to Behavioural Experiments in Cognitive Therapy.
entries.application: The Oxford Cognitive Therapy Centre standard reference for behavioural experimentation in CBT, the technique that distinguishes British clinical CBT from purely cognitive variants. Helen Kennerley is among the contributing authors. This bibliography draws on training with Kennerley directly at the Oxford Centre.

entries.title: Cognitive Therapy of Anxiety Disorders: Science and Practice.
entries.application: The standard reference for CBT as applied to anxiety. Useful where the Oracle is responding to scenario-looping, anticipatory anxiety, or worry, all of which the anxiety-CBT literature has substantial expertise on.

entries.title: Cognitive Behavior Therapy: Basics and Beyond (2nd ed).
entries.application: The current practitioner standard, written by Beck's daughter Judith. The reference clinicians use for CBT structure and technique. Cite for current-best-practice claims.

entries.authors: Hackmann, A., Bennett-Levy, J. & Holmes, E.A
entries.title: Oxford Guide to Imagery in Cognitive Therapy.
entries.application: The standard reference on imagery work within CBT, including the use of mental imagery for emotional processing, schema modification, and rescripting. Particularly relevant for CDP's capacity to surface symbolic and imagistic material in ways that intersect with cognitive change.

entries.authors: Hofmann, S.G., Asnaani, A., Vonk, I.J., Sawyer, A.T. & Fang, A
entries.title: The efficacy of cognitive behavioral therapy: A review of meta-analyses.
entries.application: The umbrella meta-analysis of meta-analyses. CBT is among the most empirically supported psychotherapies for a wide range of conditions. The single citation for the CBT-is-evidence-based claim.

entries.authors: Cuijpers, P., Berking, M., Andersson, G., Quigley, L., Kleiboer, A. & Dobson, K.S
entries.title: A meta-analysis of cognitive-behavioural therapy for adult depression, alone and in comparison with other treatments.
entries.application: The most rigorous meta-analysis of CBT for depression. Cuijpers' Amsterdam group is the leading meta-analytic team in psychotherapy research. Cite for any efficacy claim about CBT.

entries.title: Mind Over Mood: Change How You Feel by Changing the Way You Think (2nd ed).
entries.application: The most widely-used CBT self-help workbook by clinicians worldwide, Padesky being one of the most influential CBT teachers since Beck. Useful for understanding the disciplined cognitive-restructuring move at the level of practitioner practice rather than academic theory.

entries.title: A behavioral approach to depression
entries.venue: In R.J. Friedman & M.M. Katz (Eds.), The Psychology of Depression: Contemporary Theory and Research
entries.application: The original behavioural model of depression. Lewinsohn proposed that depression is maintained by a low rate of response-contingent positive reinforcement, and that scheduling activities increases reinforcement and lifts mood. The conceptual ancestor of all subsequent BA work.

entries.authors: Jacobson, N.S., Dobson, K.S., Truax, P.A., Addis, M.E., Koerner, K., Gollan, J.K., Gortner, E. & Prince, S.E
entries.title: A component analysis of cognitive-behavioral treatment for depression.
entries.application: The breakthrough study. Jacobson's component-analysis design isolated the behavioural-activation element of CBT and showed it produced equivalent outcomes to the full cognitive-plus-behavioural protocol. Action alone, without the cognitive restructuring, was as effective.

entries.authors: Martell, C.R., Addis, M.E. & Jacobson, N.S
entries.title: Depression in Context: Strategies for Guided Action.
entries.application: The first manualised statement of Behavioural Activation as a stand-alone intervention. Required reference for current BA practice.

entries.authors: Dimidjian, S., Hollon, S.D., Dobson, K.S., Schmaling, K.B., Kohlenberg, R.J., Addis, M.E., Gallop, R., McGlinchey, J.B., Markley, D.K., Gollan, J.K., Atkins, D.C., Dunner, D.L. & Jacobson, N.S
entries.title: Randomized trial of behavioral activation, cognitive therapy, and antidepressant medication in the acute treatment of adults with major depression.
entries.application: The definitive RCT. BA was equivalent to antidepressant medication and superior to cognitive therapy for severely depressed patients. The empirical pillar for any clinical claim about action-as-medicine.

entries.authors: Cuijpers, P., van Straten, A. & Warmerdam, L
entries.title: Behavioral activation treatments of depression: A meta-analysis.
entries.application: The current meta-analytic synthesis. BA produces large effect sizes for depression, comparable to or exceeding CBT and antidepressants in head-to-head comparisons. The summary citation for evidence-based BA.

entries.authors: Ekers, D., Webster, L., Van Straten, A., Cuijpers, P., Richards, D. & Gilbody, S
entries.title: Behavioural activation for depression: An update of meta-analysis of effectiveness and sub group analysis.
entries.application: The most current major meta-analysis. Confirms BA is effective and as good as CBT for depression. Cite alongside Cuijpers et al. 2007 for current consensus.

entries.title: Full Catastrophe Living: Using the Wisdom of Your Body and Mind to Face Stress, Pain, and Illness.
entries.application: The foundational MBSR text. Kabat-Zinn's breakthrough in operationalising vipassana practice for clinical contexts. The single most important reference for the modern mindfulness movement.

entries.authors: Teasdale, J.D., Segal, Z.V., Williams, J.M.G., Ridgeway, V.A., Soulsby, J.M. & Lau, M.A
entries.title: Prevention of relapse/recurrence in major depression by mindfulness-based cognitive therapy.
entries.application: The breakthrough RCT showing MBCT reduces depressive relapse in patients with three or more prior episodes by approximately fifty percent compared to treatment as usual. The empirical pillar for the clinical mindfulness literature.

entries.title: Mindfulness-based interventions in context: Past, present, and future.
entries.application: Kabat-Zinn's most-cited definitional paper. Establishes mindfulness as paying attention in a particular way: on purpose, in the present moment, non-judgmentally. The standard definition citation.

entries.authors: Hölzel, B.K., Carmody, J., Vangel, M., Congleton, C., Yerramsetti, S.M., Gard, T. & Lazar, S.W
entries.title: Mindfulness practice leads to increases in regional brain gray matter density.
entries.application: The grey-matter-density study. Eight weeks of MBSR produced measurable increases in left hippocampus, posterior cingulate cortex, and other regions. Cite for the structural-plasticity claim about meditation.

entries.authors: Hayes, S.C., Strosahl, K.D. & Wilson, K.G
entries.title: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy: The Process and Practice of Mindful Change (2nd ed).
entries.application: The foundational ACT text. Hayes' integration of mindfulness with values-based action is the closest existing therapy to CDP's combination of present-moment attention with daily orienting practice.

entries.authors: Segal, Z.V., Williams, J.M.G. & Teasdale, J.D
entries.title: Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Depression (2nd ed).
entries.application: The current MBCT manual. Required for any claim about mindfulness as a depression-relapse-prevention intervention.

entries.authors: Goyal, M., Singh, S., Sibinga, E.M.S., Gould, N.F., Rowland-Seymour, A., Sharma, R., Berger, Z., Sleicher, D., Maron, D.D., Shihab, H.M., Ranasinghe, P.D., Linn, S., Saha, S., Bass, E.B. & Haythornthwaite, J.A
entries.title: Meditation programs for psychological stress and well-being: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
entries.application: The Johns Hopkins meta-analysis published in JAMA Internal Medicine. The most rigorous summary of the meditation literature. Establishes moderate evidence for mindfulness in reducing anxiety, depression, and pain. The honest baseline citation for what meditation has and has not been shown to do.

entries.authors: Tang, Y.Y., Hölzel, B.K. & Posner, M.I
entries.title: The neuroscience of mindfulness meditation.
entries.application: The Nature Reviews Neuroscience synthesis of meditation's neural effects. Documents changes in attention networks, default mode network, body awareness, emotional regulation, and self-perspective. The single best reference for the brain-changes claim about meditation.

entries.title: Descartes' Error: Emotion, Reason, and the Human Brain.
entries.application: Damasio's foundational somatic-marker hypothesis. Establishes that emotion is not the enemy of reason but its substrate. The philosophical hinge for any embodied-cognition claim.

entries.title: Waking the Tiger: Healing Trauma.
entries.application: The foundational text of Somatic Experiencing. Levine's observation that animals discharge survival energy through trembling and movement, and that humans benefit from completing this process, is the operative principle behind body-based trauma work.

entries.title: Philosophy in the Flesh: The Embodied Mind and Its Challenge to Western Thought.
entries.application: The most thorough philosophical defence of embodied cognition. Argues that abstract reason is metaphorically structured by bodily experience. Background for any claim that contemplative practice integrates mind and body rather than separating them.

entries.title: Handbook of Clinical Massage: A Complete Guide for Students and Practitioners (2nd ed).
entries.application: Standard reference for clinical massage including acupressure technique. Useful as the practitioner reference for hands-on bodywork integrating multiple traditions of touch.

entries.title: Relationship of acupuncture points and meridians to connective tissue planes.
entries.application: The Vermont mechanism paper. Maps acupuncture points to connective-tissue plane intersections, providing an anatomical substrate that connects traditional point locations to modern fascia research. Background for the somatic-tradition references.

entries.authors: White, A., Cummings, M. & Filshie, J
entries.title: An Introduction to Western Medical Acupuncture.
entries.application: The British Medical Acupuncture Society standard. Western Medical Acupuncture interprets the traditional points through musculoskeletal and neurological mechanisms, providing a defensible bridge between the ancient practice and contemporary pain physiology. This bibliography draws on formal training in Western Medical Acupuncture.

entries.title: In an Unspoken Voice: How the Body Releases Trauma and Restores Goodness.
entries.application: Levine's mature statement of the Somatic Experiencing framework. The current standard reference.

entries.title: Self Comes to Mind: Constructing the Conscious Brain.
entries.application: Damasio's mature theory of consciousness as built up from body-mapping in the brainstem and insula. Important for the claim that the higher self is rooted in bodily integration, not separate from it.

entries.title: The Body Keeps the Score: Brain, Mind, and Body in the Healing of Trauma.
entries.application: The most widely-read modern synthesis of trauma neuroscience and somatic therapeutic approaches. Required for any reference to body-based trauma work in popular discourse.

entries.authors: Vickers, A.J., Vertosick, E.A., Lewith, G., MacPherson, H., Foster, N.E., Sherman, K.J., Irnich, D., Witt, C.M. & Linde, K
entries.title: Acupuncture for chronic pain: Update of an individual patient data meta-analysis.
entries.application: The definitive individual-patient-data meta-analysis. Establishes that acupuncture produces clinically meaningful effects for chronic musculoskeletal, headache, and osteoarthritis pain that exceed placebo. The most rigorous current evidence summary.

entries.title: Sai Baba: Man of Miracles.
entries.application: Murphet was a former Royal Air Force officer and journalist; his careful biographical work is among the most measured Western accounts of Sai Baba's life and teaching. Useful as a starting reference for users new to the lineage.

entries.title: Redemptive Encounters: Three Modern Styles in the Hindu Tradition.
entries.application: Babb's Amherst College anthropological treatment of contemporary Hindu devotional movements, including the Sai Baba movement. The standard scholarly external reference.

entries.title: A Path with Heart: A Guide Through the Perils and Promises of Spiritual Life.
entries.application: Kornfield's integration of Theravada Buddhist practice with Western psychological insight. The standard reference for contemplative practice as it lands in modern Western lives.

entries.title: Philosophy as a Way of Life: Spiritual Exercises from Socrates to Foucault (M
entries.application: Hadot's recovery of ancient philosophy as lived spiritual practice. The philosophical defence of why a daily reflection practice has substantive value, not merely psychological benefit.

entries.title: Satipatthana: The Direct Path to Realization.
entries.application: The most rigorous contemporary scholarly treatment of the foundational Buddhist text on mindfulness practice. Required for any claim about the Pali-canonical roots of modern mindfulness.

entries.title: Contemplative Science: Where Buddhism and Neuroscience Converge.
entries.application: Wallace was a Buddhist monk and is a contemporary academic. His treatment of contemplative practice as scientifically tractable and philosophically rigorous is foundational for CDP's combination of contemplative depth with empirical grounding.

entries.title: In the Presence of Sai Baba: Body, City, and Memory in a Global Religious Movement.
entries.application: Smriti Srinivas (UC Davis) provides the most thorough scholarly study of the global Sai Baba movement and its embodied practices. Useful for understanding the contemporary devotional context.

entries.title: Winged Faith: Rethinking Globalization and Religious Pluralism Through the Sathya Sai Movement.
entries.application: Tulasi Srinivas (Emerson) on the Sai Baba movement's global character and its teachings on religious unity (Sarva Dharma). Important for cross-framework synthesis claims.

entries.title: How to Think Like a Roman Emperor: The Stoic Philosophy of Marcus Aurelius.
entries.application: Robertson is a CBT therapist and Stoic-philosophy scholar; this book explicitly bridges Stoic spiritual exercises with contemporary cognitive-behavioural practice. Important for the claim that the Compass is doing what Stoics did, supported now by what CBT has empirically validated.

entries.title: Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience.
entries.application: The foundational Flow text. Identifies the state of absorbed engagement as the reliable correlate of intrinsic satisfaction. Important for any reading that names engagement as a value.

entries.title: Self-determination theory and the facilitation of intrinsic motivation, social development, and well-being.
entries.application: The foundational SDT paper. Establishes autonomy, competence, and relatedness as universal psychological needs. The most-cited paper in motivation research. Essential for the design claim that the Compass satisfies SDT needs by its structure, not only its content.

entries.title: Authentic Happiness: Using the New Positive Psychology to Realize Your Potential for Lasting Fulfillment.
entries.application: The first major popular statement of positive psychology. Established the field as a counter-orientation to deficit-focused clinical psychology.

entries.title: The development and validation of a scale to measure self-compassion.
entries.application: The original self-compassion scale paper. Establishes self-compassion as the combination of self-kindness, common humanity, and mindfulness. The empirical foundation for the construct.

entries.title: The Compassionate Mind: A New Approach to Life's Challenges.
entries.application: Gilbert's Compassion Focused Therapy, developed for clients whose self-criticism blocks standard CBT. The clinical extension of self-compassion research. Important for the Oracle's capacity to meet self-critical patterns with explicit clinical authority.

entries.title: Flourish: A Visionary New Understanding of Happiness and Well-Being.
entries.application: Seligman's mature PERMA model (Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment). The current reference for the multi-dimensional structure of wellbeing.

entries.title: A pilot study and randomized controlled trial of the mindful self-compassion program.
entries.application: The MSC efficacy trial. Demonstrates that self-compassion is trainable and that training reduces depression, anxiety, and stress. Cite for any clinical claim about self-compassion as a learnable practice.

entries.title: The nature and organization of individual differences in executive functions: Four general conclusions.
entries.application: The unity-and-diversity framework of EF: a common factor underlies all EF tasks, with separable components for working memory updating and shifting. Important for any claim about EF as both a general and a specific capacity.

entries.authors: Hofmann, W., Schmeichel, B.J. & Baddeley, A.D
entries.title: Executive functions and self-regulation.
entries.application: The explicit linkage of executive function to self-regulation. Establishes that self-regulatory capacity is grounded in working memory and inhibitory control. Cite for any claim about the Compass as cultivation of self-regulation.

entries.title: Executive functions.
entries.application: The standard current reference on executive function. Diamond identifies inhibitory control, working memory, and cognitive flexibility as the three core EFs. The foundational citation for any EF claim.

entries.title: Conclusions about interventions, programs, and approaches for improving executive functions that appear justified and those that, despite much hype, do not.
entries.application: Diamond's honest meta-review of what EF interventions have and have not been shown to do. Important for keeping CDP's claims honest about what daily practice can plausibly cultivate.

entries.title: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi on the Bhagavad-Gita: A New Translation and Commentary, Chapters 1-6.
entries.application: Maharishi's primary published statement of the philosophical framework underlying Transcendental Meditation, presented through commentary on the Bhagavad-Gita. The doctrinal source for the TM tradition.

entries.title: Focused attention, open monitoring and automatic self-transcending: Categories to organize meditations from Vedic, Buddhist and Chinese traditions.
entries.application: Establishes a three-category taxonomy of meditation techniques and places TM in a distinct category (automatic self-transcending) with its own neural signature, separate from focused-attention practices like concentrative meditation and open-monitoring practices like vipassana. Important for the claim that TM is methodologically distinct from MBSR-style practice.

entries.authors: Schneider, R.H., Grim, C.E., Rainforth, M.V., Kotchen, T., Nidich, S.I., Gaylord-King, C., Salerno, J.W., Kotchen, J.M. & Alexander, C.N
entries.title: Stress reduction in the secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: Randomized, controlled trial of Transcendental Meditation and health education in Blacks.
entries.application: NIH-funded randomised trial showing TM reduced cardiovascular events by 48 percent in patients with established coronary disease over an average 5.4 year follow-up. Among the strongest single empirical findings for any meditation practice in cardiovascular outcome research.

entries.title: Effects of the Transcendental Meditation technique on trait anxiety: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
entries.application: Meta-analysis of TM trials on trait anxiety. Establishes effect sizes that exceed comparison meditation and relaxation interventions on this specific outcome.

The Science paper that first brought TM into the peer-reviewed scientific literature. Demonstrated reliable physiological signatures (oxygen consumption, skin resistance, EEG) distinct from rest or sleep. The historical inflection point.

entries.title: Reiki: The Original Hand Position System.
entries.application: Phyllis Furumoto, granddaughter of Hawayo Takata and lineage holder of the Usui Shiki Ryōhō tradition until her death in 2019, is the primary modern reference within the lineage. This bibliography draws on training with Furumoto directly.

entries.authors: Lübeck, W., Petter, F.A. & Rand, W.L
entries.title: The Spirit of Reiki: The Complete Handbook of the Reiki System.
entries.application: The most thorough Western-practitioner synthesis. Useful for readers seeking the contemporary practitioner standard outside the closed lineage tradition.

entries.authors: Lee, M.S., Pittler, M.H. & Ernst, E
entries.title: Effects of reiki in clinical practice: A systematic review of randomised clinical trials.
entries.application: The strongest sceptical systematic review. Identified nine RCTs and concluded that the evidence was insufficient to suggest reiki is an effective treatment for any condition. The honest counterweight that any practitioner-led claim about reiki must be held against. Cite alongside the more recent positive meta-analyses for the full evidentiary picture.

entries.authors: vanderVaart, S., Gijsen, V.M.G.J., de Wildt, S.N. & Koren, G
entries.title: A systematic review of the therapeutic effects of Reiki.
entries.application: The systematic review. Concludes that the existing trial evidence is suggestive but methodologically limited, with effects most consistent on anxiety, pain, and depression. Honest framing reference.

entries.title: Effect of Reiki therapy on pain and anxiety in adults: An in-depth literature review of randomized trials with effect size calculations.
entries.application: University of Pittsburgh nursing review focused on pain and anxiety outcomes. Documents moderate effect sizes in nursing-led trials, particularly in cancer and post-surgical contexts. The reference behind Reiki's presence in major US integrative-medicine programmes.

entries.title: Reiki for depression and anxiety.
entries.application: The Cochrane review. The highest standard of evidence assessment, concludes that high-quality trials are limited and that more rigorous research is needed. Required citation for any honest claim about the current evidence base.

entries.title: Reiki is better than placebo and has broad potential as a complementary health therapy.
entries.application: The most explicit comparative review of reiki versus placebo controls. Reviewed thirteen studies and concluded reiki produced effects beyond placebo on pain, anxiety, and depression. Required citation for any honest claim that the effects of reiki are not entirely accounted for by expectation alone. Read alongside Lee, Pittler and Ernst 2008 for both sides of the methodological debate.

entries.title: The effect of reiki on pain: A meta-analysis.
entries.application: Pain-specific meta-analysis. Identified consistent moderate effects of reiki on pain reduction across heterogeneous clinical populations, with heterogeneity in study quality. The first meta-analysis specifically focused on pain outcomes; informs CDP's claim that touch-with-attention modalities have measurable effects in clinical contexts.

entries.authors: Morero, J.A.P., de Souza Pereira, S., Esteves, R.B. & Cardoso, L
entries.title: Effects of reiki on mental health care: A systematic review.
entries.application: The mental-health-focused systematic review. Surveys reiki applications across anxiety, depression, and stress conditions, identifying consistent effects with the methodological caveats common to the field. The reference for CDP's positioning that touch-with-attention practices have measurable effects in mental-health contexts that are not reducible to placebo alone.

entries.authors: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH)
entries.title: Reiki: What you need to know.
entries.application: The official US government position on reiki. Acknowledges that some studies have found benefits while noting that most clinical research has methodological limitations and that the energy field central to reiki claims has not been demonstrated by physical measurement. The required institutional reference. Including this is part of the discipline of representing the evidence honestly rather than only positively, which is what the Two Telescopes premise demands.

entries.authors: Liu, K., Qin, Z., Qin, Y., et al
entries.title: Effects of reiki therapy on quality of life: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
entries.application: The most current major meta-analysis. Six hundred and sixty-one RCT participants pooled across studies through September 2024, showing significant enhancement in quality of life post-reiki therapy (SMD = 0.28, 95 percent CI 0.01 to 0.56, p = 0.043), with subgroup analysis indicating greatest effects with eight or more sessions of sixty minutes or longer. The current top-of-evidence reference for any claim about reiki's effects on quality of life. Cite as the lead recent systematic review when current evidence is the issue.

entries.title: The effect of reiki on pain, anxiety, and hemodynamic parameters during the perioperative period: A meta-analysis study.
entries.application: The most current perioperative reiki meta-analysis. Demonstrates measurable effects on pain, anxiety, and autonomic markers in surgical populations where the comparison conditions are well-defined. Reference for the specific claim that touch-with-attention practices produce measurable autonomic and subjective shifts in highly-controlled clinical conditions.

entries.title: Behaviorally conditioned immunosuppression.
entries.application: The founding paper of psychoneuroimmunology. Demonstrated that classical conditioning could produce immunosuppression, establishing that the immune system is regulated by the nervous system rather than autonomous. The paper that opened the field.

entries.authors: Cohen, S., Doyle, W.J., Skoner, D.P., Rabin, B.S. & Gwaltney, J.M
entries.title: Social ties and susceptibility to the common cold.
entries.application: The classic social-support-and-immunity demonstration. People with more diverse social ties were less susceptible to viral infection after standardised exposure, in a dose-response gradient. The single cleanest empirical finding linking social connection to immune competence.

entries.title: The Balance Within: The Science Connecting Health and Emotions.
entries.application: Sternberg, formerly chief of NIMH neuroendocrinology and now at the University of Arizona, provides the most accessible synthesis of psychoneuroimmunology for a wider readership without sacrificing rigour. Useful for explaining the field to non-specialists.

entries.authors: Kiecolt-Glaser, J.K., McGuire, L., Robles, T.F. & Glaser, R
entries.title: Psychoneuroimmunology: Psychological influences on immune function and health.
entries.application: Kiecolt-Glaser's Ohio State group has produced the most consistent body of work showing psychological influences on wound healing, vaccination response, and inflammatory markers. This review summarises their findings through 2002; their subsequent work continues to be foundational.

entries.title: Psychological stress and the human immune system: A meta-analytic study of 30 years of inquiry.
entries.application: The Psychological Bulletin meta-analysis covering three decades of research on psychological stress and immune function. The single most-cited summary of the stress-immunity relationship.

entries.title: Psychoneuroimmunology (4th ed, 2 vols).
entries.application: The canonical handbook of the field, edited by its founder. The single reference for any claim about the mechanisms by which psychological and behavioural states affect immune function. The 4th edition is the current standard.

entries.authors: Cole, S.W., Hawkley, L.C., Arevalo, J.M., Sung, C.Y., Rose, R.M. & Cacioppo, J.T
entries.title: Social regulation of gene expression in human leukocytes.
entries.application: Cole's UCLA group identified the Conserved Transcriptional Response to Adversity (CTRA), a gene-expression signature that shifts in response to chronic threat and isolation, and reverses with positive social and contemplative interventions. Among the most important psychoneuroimmunology findings of the past two decades.

entries.authors: Pace, T.W.W., Negi, L.T., Adame, D.D., Cole, S.P., Sivilli, T.I., Brown, T.D., Issa, M.J. & Raison, C.L
entries.title: Effect of compassion meditation on neuroendocrine, innate immune and behavioral responses to psychosocial stress.
entries.application: Emory University RCT showing compassion meditation produced measurable reductions in inflammatory and behavioural responses to psychosocial stress. Direct empirical bridge between contemplative practice and immune function.

entries.title: Psychoneuroimmunology: An introduction to immune-to-brain communication and its implications for clinical psychology.
entries.application: The current Annual Review synthesis of psychoneuroimmunology for the clinical psychology field. The most accessible and authoritative recent overview of immune-to-brain communication, neuroimmune networks, and the clinical implications for depression, PTSD, anxiety, and psychosis. Required citation for any claim about the current consensus state of PNI in the clinical-psychology context that CDP operates within.

entries.authors: Mengelkoch, S., Gassen, J., Slavich, G.M
entries.title: Multi-omics approaches to investigate stress and the immune system.
entries.application: The current methodological frontier in psychoneuroimmunology. UCLA Stress Lab review of multi-omics integration (genome, proteome, transcriptome, metabolome, microbiome) for investigating how psychological states affect immune function. Citation for the claim that contemporary PNI is a high-resolution biological field rather than a soft mind-body proposal.

entries.title: The beneficial effects of social support and prosocial behavior on immunity and health: A psychoneuroimmunology perspective.
entries.application: The current synthesis specifically on social support, prosocial behaviour, and immune outcomes. Tel Aviv and UCLA collaboration covering loneliness, social support, prosocial behaviour, and their respective immune signatures. The contemporary equivalent of the Cohen, House, Spiegel literature, written for the post-COVID era. Required citation for any claim CDP makes about social connection and physiological wellbeing.

entries.authors: Kuhn, A.M., Bosis, K.E. & Wohleb, E.S
entries.title: Looking back to move forward: Research in stress, behavior, and immune function.
entries.application: The current historical-and-prospective review of PNI as a field. Useful for the contextual claim that PNI's claims have moved from speculative to mechanistically grounded over the past century, and for situating the contemporary mind-body bridge research within an established empirical tradition.

The Science paper synthesising the epidemiological evidence that social isolation is a mortality risk factor comparable in magnitude to smoking, hypertension, and obesity. Foundational reference for the claim that relationship matters for health at the level of survival.

The Stanford support-group survival study. Patients with metastatic breast cancer who participated in weekly support groups lived approximately twice as long as controls. Among the most-cited and most-debated findings in psychosocial oncology, and a touchstone for the social-support-survival literature.

entries.title: The Innovator's Dilemma: When New Technologies Cause Great Firms to Fail.
entries.application: The foundational text on disruptive innovation. Establishes the argument that established organisations fail not by doing things wrong but by listening too closely to existing customers and missing emerging needs. Background for any strategic conversation about positioning.

entries.title: Business Model Generation: A Handbook for Visionaries, Game Changers, and Challengers.
entries.application: The Business Model Canvas. The primary reference for the nine-block framework that has become the standard tool for articulating how value is created, delivered, and captured. Foundational for any strategic conversation about what an organisation actually does.

entries.title: Running Lean: Iterate from Plan A to a Plan That Works (2nd ed).
entries.application: The Lean Canvas, Maurya's adaptation of the BMC for early-stage ventures, with explicit problem-solution-fit emphasis. Useful as a complementary tool for very early-stage strategic conversations.

entries.authors: Osterwalder, A., Pigneur, Y., Bernarda, G. & Smith, A
entries.title: Value Proposition Design: How to Create Products and Services Customers Want.
entries.application: The Value Proposition Canvas, including the customer profile (jobs to be done, pains, gains) and the value map (products and services, pain relievers, gain creators). The single best operational tool for the discipline of meeting users where they actually are. Directly relevant to how the Oracle can support users navigating relational and strategic questions.

entries.title: Hooked: How to Build Habit-Forming Products.
entries.application: The Hook Model, useful as a structural framework for understanding how product-design choices affect user engagement and behaviour. Cited here with the explicit caveat that CDP's product orientation is the opposite of the addictive-engagement design Eyal documents; the framework is useful for understanding the territory CDP has chosen not to occupy.

entries.authors: Christensen, C.M., Hall, T., Dillon, K. & Duncan, D.S
entries.title: Competing Against Luck: The Story of Innovation and Customer Choice.
entries.application: Christensen's canonical statement of the Jobs-to-be-Done framework. People do not buy products; they hire products to do a job in their lives. The single best reference for the JTBD discipline. Particularly relevant to how the Oracle thinks about what a user is actually asking for when they type a line into the Compass.

entries.title: Jobs to be Done: Theory to Practice.
entries.application: The operational manual for putting JTBD into practice, by the practitioner who originated much of the formalisation underlying Christensen's framework. The methodology reference for moving from JTBD as concept to JTBD as analytical discipline.

entries.title: Testing Business Ideas: A Field Guide for Rapid Experimentation.
entries.application: The Strategyzer-Precoil collaboration on disciplined experimentation. The methodology for testing assumptions before committing resources, drawing on lean startup and design thinking traditions but with greater rigour. This bibliography draws on training in Testing Business Ideas with David J. Bland directly.

entries.title: Philosophical Investigations (G.E.M
entries.application: The later Wittgenstein on language as constitutive of world rather than merely descriptive of it. Foundational for the constructivist position that the words we use to interpret events shape what those events become.

entries.title: Speech Acts: An Essay in the Philosophy of Language.
entries.application: Searle on the world-creating function of speech acts (declarations, commitments, promises). The Landmark methodology draws explicitly on this lineage in its account of how language creates possibility rather than merely describing it.

entries.title: Werner Erhard: The Transformation of a Man, the Founding of est.
entries.application: Bartley was a philosopher of science (Karl Popper's student); his biographical and intellectual treatment of Erhard remains the most rigorous historical reference for the founding of est and the philosophical lineage feeding it.

entries.title: Autopoiesis and Cognition: The Realization of the Living.
entries.application: The autopoietic theory of cognition. Establishes that perception is structure-determined: the system's organisation determines what counts as a perturbation, not the world itself. Provides biological-systems grounding for the constructivist position that Landmark articulates as the already-always listening.

entries.title: The narrative construction of reality.
entries.application: Bruner on narrative as the fundamental mode of cognition for human meaning-making. The cognitive-science complement to McAdams' personality-psychology treatment. Background for the claim that the morning Compass entry is, among other things, a small narrative-identity act.

entries.title: The Stories We Live By: Personal Myths and the Making of the Self.
entries.application: McAdams' founding text on narrative identity. Establishes that the self is constituted through the ongoing story we tell about who we have been, who we are, and who we are becoming. Closest empirical cousin to the Erhard meaning-making framework within mainstream personality psychology.

entries.title: Outrageous Betrayal: The Dark Journey of Werner Erhard from est to Exile.
entries.application: The principal critical biography. Cited here in service of intellectual honesty: the Erhard lineage has substantial academic and journalistic critiques alongside its practitioner literature, and the bibliography that draws on the lineage owes the reader the complete picture rather than the curated one.

entries.title: Narrative identity and meaning making across the adult lifespan: An introduction.
entries.application: Singer's introduction to the special-issue treatment of narrative identity in adulthood. The contemporary research-literature grounding for the longitudinal claims about how meaning-making changes shape across a life.

entries.authors: Erhard, W., Jensen, M.C. & Granger, K.L
entries.title: Creating leaders: An ontological/phenomenological model
entries.venue: In S. Snook, N. Nohria & R. Khurana (Eds.), The Handbook for Teaching Leadership
entries.application: Erhard's academic-press chapter, co-authored with Michael Jensen of Harvard Business School. The cleanest single statement of the ontological-phenomenological framework underlying the est-Forum-Landmark lineage. The most defensible academic citation for the constructivist meaning-making position.
